NJ's Recall

Signed releases of Recall, NJ's personal flashcard app. This repository holds only the APKs and this index; the source code is private.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AndrzejMnM/recall-fdroid/main/repo
